newsitem.title: KYRGYZSTAN: Kyrgyzstan grain harvest complete at 1.49 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Kyrgyzstan grain harvest complete at 1.49 mln T.

text.p: The Central Asian republic of Kyrgyzstan's 1996 grain harvest rose to 1.49 million tonnes, a senior official in charge of agricultural reform said late on Monday.
"Of the total, wheat made up 1.042 million tonnes," Kabylbek Dzhumaliyev, head of agricultural reform within the president's administration, told a news conference in the capital Bishkek.
Kyrgyzstan harvested 980,000 tonnes of grain in 1995.
This year's harvest was higher than the 1.3 million tonnes forecast by the former Soviet republic's National Statistics Committee.
Dzhumaliyev said 800,000 tonnes of wheat would be needed to feed Kyrgyzstan's 4.5 million population over the coming year while a further 135,000 tonnes would be used for seeds.
"This year the harvest is even above the republic's own needs," said Dzhumaliyev.
However, he said problems remained in the storage and milling of grain. He said the average yield for wheat this year was 2.41 tonnes per hectare. --Almaty Newsroom +7 3272 509410
